summary: End-to-end testing of GROOM2B redesign. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (contact + bookings; validation for missing/bad date/bad email; null email accepted; newest-first sort; no _id). Frontend: preview reliable (5/5 200 for / and /collections?c=swarnalayam). Desktop: mega menu (Collections=6 tiles, Shop=7 categories+6 occasions+2 features) opens on hover, closes on Escape; mega-collection-namam navigates and sets correct title. Collections page: rail switching, category filter, chips, clear all, URL-persisted filters, sort price-asc, search, 12-per-page + Load more (12→24), empty state, quickview (title+price+thumbs), book-this-look prefills interest/category/occasion, booking 4-step flow with proper validation (Continue disabled until valid, bad email blocks, Back preserves selections, 'Not sure yet' exclusive), POST /api/bookings success + summary shows outfit, Done closes, reopen starts fresh at step 1, Escape+backdrop close, body scroll locked by Modal. Contact form still POSTs and shows success. Palette maroon/wine + gold + ivory; no green found. Mobile (390x844): no horizontal overflow; mobile-menu drawer opens with accordions and book button; filters-sheet works and 'Show N styles' apply; sticky-book-btn appears after scroll; booking modal is 94% viewport height. One real defect: mobile drawer does NOT set body.style.overflow=hidden (only calls lenis.stop), so page behind can still be scrolled with native touch while the drawer is open.

ui_bugs.issue: Body scroll not locked while drawer is open — Nav.jsx only calls window.__lenis?.stop() but does not set document.body.style.overflow='hidden'. On mobile the page behind can still scroll via native touch, violating 'page behind does not scroll while open'.

action_items: Fix mobile drawer body-scroll lock: in Nav.jsx drawer effect, additionally set document.body.style.overflow='hidden' while drawer is open (restore on cleanup), matching the pattern used in Modal.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx lines 29-33: drawer effect only stops Lenis; add body overflow lock to mirror Modal.jsx behaviour. Otherwise native touch scroll still moves page under the fixed drawer on mobile.
BookingModal submit: trims name/phone/email and sends email:null when empty — matches backend's Optional[EmailStr]. Good.
Collections.jsx uses `scrollToTop` on `f.c` change only; fine, works on arrival to /collections via URL.
QuickView correctly prefills booking via openBooking({ interest, outfits:[category], occasion: occasions[0] }); summary shows outfit name under 'Outfit you liked'.
No file >700 lines; env vars used correctly; status codes/pydantic validation appropriate.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all listed feature flows pass; 1 UX bug (mobile drawer body-scroll lock)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed contact leads and bookings via API + UI (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL stable (5x 200). Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers contact + bookings with /frontend/.env load. Landing testids: hero-book-stylist-btn, hero-explore-collections-btn (no hero-shop-all-btn — the 'Shop all styles' CTA lives in Arrivals as arrivals-view-all-link). Arrivals '+' testid is product-quickview-btn-{i} (not arrival-add-{i}) and correctly calls openBooking({interest:p.name}). On booking Back from step3→step2 there can be a brief animation frame where tiles aren't yet attached (AnimatePresence mode='wait'); add ~500ms wait after Back before querying. Only outstanding issue: Nav drawer body scroll lock.
rca of the issue: Mobile drawer scroll leak — Nav.jsx drawer-open effect calls window.__lenis?.stop() but omits document.body.style.overflow='hidden'. Lenis stop prevents programmatic smooth-scroll only; native touch scrolling of document.body remains active on mobile Safari/Chrome, so the content behind the fixed drawer still scrolls. Fix: mirror Modal.jsx — in the drawer effect, set body.style.overflow='hidden' when drawer opens and restore on cleanup.
